title: Wa ghareebaa wa shaheedaa
body:
Wa ghareeban wa shahedan Wa Husain ibne Ali(as)
1. Dasht me ghar tera luta Haay husaina Tujhko kafan bhi na mila Haay husaina Rounda gaya lasha tera haay husaina
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Ghodoun say pamaal huwa Dilbaray shabbar Rehgaye sehray kay sobhi Phool bikhar kar Tukhdoun ko Qasim uthatay rahay sarwar
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Hogayi beyaro madadgaar Sakina Sehti rahi durron ki bochard Sakina Roti rahi lashay pay lachaar Sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Maragaya bhai tera Shanay katakar Khake sina seenay pay Soya Ali Akber Qatl huwa teeray sitamgaar say Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Lashay uthatay huwe din Tune guzara Chin gaya maqtal mein har ek Tera Sahara Dekhkay ghurbat teri khaleq ne pukara
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Yaade Hussain ibne Ali likh gayi Zainab Dasht me jab Shaam Dhali lut gayi Zainab Qaid hui Shaam chali lut gayi Zainab
